maria_cs: Quick weekly account health snapshot for Harbor — focusing on 95th/99th tail by route+model and streaming vs non-streaming. Dropping the raw numbers below. TL;DR: streaming helps short-chat p99 but we see p99 regressions on long-context routes for Llama-70b; also slight uptick in errors and cost (see notes).

jasper_eng: thanks. can you paste the numbers? want to check whether this is infra or model IO. :eyes:

maria_cs: sure — table from telemetry (last 7d):
```
ROUTE            | MODEL           | MODE         | p95 (ms) | p99 (ms) | errors (%)
chat-short       | llama-2-13b-q   | streaming    | 320      | 680      | 0.12%
chat-short       | llama-2-13b-q   | non-stream   | 410      | 950      | 0.08%
summarize-long   | mixtral-8x      | streaming    | 860      | 2300     | 0.50%
summarize-long   | mixtral-8x      | non-stream   | 920      | 2100     | 0.45%
long-context     | llama-2-70b     | streaming    | 1400     | 3800     | 1.20%
long-context     | llama-2-70b     | non-stream   | 1100     | 2900     | 0.90%
```

natasha_data: notes from analysis — streaming reduces median and p95 on short outputs (smaller prefix flushes), but we see KV cache miss amplification on long contexts: when cache miss rate > 8% p99 jumps sharply (seen on Llama-70b streaming). Also higher error burstiness on streaming for long tokens (likely backpressure/resends).

leo_sre: any deploys/infra changes mid-week? ops-bot: `autoscaleservice:v2` rolled to canary on 3126549200, 2 nodes replaced.

jasper_eng: ok that can explain small bump but not the entire p99 spike. Two things to triage: 1) look at prefix cache TTL and cold-start penalties for streaming on >8k context; 2) check our streaming chunk sizes and retry behavior for large responses.

maria_cs: capture on product-side: Harbor trial noticed 12% more spend week-over-week (driven by retries and longer p99 tail). Renewal risk flagged: medium. Customer comment: "Best for short chat but long-task summaries are flaky".

natasha_data: suggested mitigations from data team:
- enable conservative KV-binding for long-context routes (reduce cache churn)
- increase streaming chunking threshold to 512 bytes for long outputs
- add p99 alert at route level with 5-min burn-in

leo_sre: operational actions I can take now:
- bump prefix cache TTL from 60s -> 180s for long-context routes (testing in canary)
- add backpressure metrics + distinguish retry vs client-abort in traces

jasper_eng: engineering follow-ups:
- audit streaming retry policy: ensure we don't replay entire generation on transient errors (could explode cost)
- add canary routing rule: when p99(streaming,long-context) > 3s fallback to non-stream for new requests for 10m

maria_cs: risk/opportunity: if fallback to non-stream works, short-chat user impact negligible, long tasks get more stable p99 and fewer retries -> cost down. Will surface to Harbor PM.

ops-bot: action created: CS-2874 (notify customer + add mitigation plan).

maria_cs: action items summarized:
- @jasper_eng: audit retry behavior + implement fallback rule (ETA Thu EOD)
- @leo_sre: roll prefix TTL canary and add backpressure metrics (ETA Thu AM)
- @natasha_data: compute p99-by-context-length histogram and share by EOD (helps tune threshold)
- @maria_cs: notify Harbor with summary and temporary config change notes

jasper_eng: acked. will post PR link once I have a small change for retry policy.

leo_sre: ack. will post canary logs and traces.

maria_cs: thanks all — syncing Thursday 10:00 PT in #cs-ops-bridge to confirm mitigations. :thumbsup:

natasha_data: FYI i'll add a short eval prompt set for Harbor to catch regressions next deploy.

maria_cs: perfect. closing thread for now but will re-open if anything spikes before Thu.
